description: This file defines a class 'Filter' with static methods for filtering arrays based on lookup and match arrays, used in spreadsheet calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Provides static methods for filtering lookup arrays based on match arrays in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a lookup array using a match array, handling empty results with optional fallback.

methods.name: enumerateArrayKeys
methods.description: Normalizes array keys by reindexing nested arrays and the top-level array.

methods.name: filterByRow
methods.description: Filters the lookup array based on a match array, treating the match array as row indicators.

methods.name: filterByColumn
methods.description: Filters the lookup array based on a match array, treating the match array as column indicators, and transposes matrices as needed.
